scenarios.title: Legitimate delegation executes
scenarios.expected_decision: EOA delegated to a benign implementation runs its code

scenarios.title: Malicious delegation drains the EOA
scenarios.expected_decision: EOA delegated to a hostile implementation loses its whole balance to the attacker's call

scenarios.title: Delegation revocation clears the code
scenarios.expected_decision: Delegating to address(0) removes the code; the implementation no longer runs

scenarios.title: Delegation authorisation cannot be replayed
scenarios.expected_decision: Attaching the same signed authorisation twice is rejected

scenarios.title: Executor may use the allowlisted target
scenarios.expected_decision: Executor call to the allowlisted target succeeds

scenarios.title: Executor may not call privileged functions directly
scenarios.expected_decision: Executor setOwner call reverts, owner unchanged

scenarios.title: Executor may not self-call
scenarios.expected_decision: Executor execute() to the account itself reverts

scenarios.title: Executor may not delegatecall
scenarios.expected_decision: Executor executeDelegate call reverts, owner unchanged

scenarios.title: Batch authorisation is atomic
scenarios.expected_decision: Allowed batch succeeds; mixed batch reverts with no partial effects; owner batch with self-call succeeds

scenarios.title: Module installation is owner-only
scenarios.expected_decision: Non-owner install reverts; owner install succeeds

scenarios.title: Installed module may execute the target
scenarios.expected_decision: Installed module call to the target succeeds

scenarios.title: Module limits hold
scenarios.expected_decision: Module cannot self-call, cannot install another module, loses execution on uninstall

scenarios.title: Session key expiry enforced
scenarios.expected_decision: Expired session key rejected on the correct account; the same expired key executes on variant F

scenarios.title: Session key spending limit enforced
scenarios.expected_decision: Within-limit calls succeed and spend accumulates; overspend rejected; overspend executes on variant F

scenarios.title: Session key target enforced
scenarios.expected_decision: Call to a target outside the key's allowlist rejected; executes on variant F

scenarios.title: Session key revocation enforced
scenarios.expected_decision: Revoked key rejected; the same revoked key executes on variant F

scenarios.title: Valid UserOperation executes
scenarios.expected_decision: Validated owner operation executes, nonce consumed

scenarios.title: Bad signature rejected
scenarios.expected_decision: Operation signed by a non-owner is rejected, nothing executes

scenarios.title: Wrong nonce rejected
scenarios.expected_decision: Operation with a non-current nonce is rejected

scenarios.title: Expiry enforced
scenarios.expected_decision: Expired operation rejected, unexpired operation accepted

scenarios.title: Validation is EntryPoint-only
scenarios.expected_decision: Direct validateUserOp calls and validator/executor validation attempts revert

scenarios.title: Validator change is owner-only
scenarios.expected_decision: Only the owner can change the validator; with no validator, validation fails

scenarios.title: Owner self-call through UserOperation
scenarios.expected_decision: Owner admin work inside a validated operation succeeds

scenarios.title: Variant A: direct privileged call
scenarios.expected_decision: Attacker sets owner directly on the vulnerable account; blocked on the correct account

scenarios.title: Variant B: unrestricted module install
scenarios.expected_decision: Attacker installs a hostile module and drains funds on the vulnerable account; blocked on the correct account

scenarios.title: Variant C: delegatecall by executor
scenarios.expected_decision: Executor overwrites the owner via delegatecall on the vulnerable account; blocked on the correct account

scenarios.title: Variant D: nonce replay
scenarios.expected_decision: Same signed operation executes twice on the vulnerable account; second execution rejected on the correct account

scenarios.title: Variant E: self-call by executor
scenarios.expected_decision: Executor sets owner via self-call on the vulnerable account; blocked on the correct account, and the direct call is still blocked on the variant itself
